answer: Splitting into 7 separate vaults requires a separate funded plume account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The raven explorer shows the whole merge tree. A 98 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
